import datetime,hashlib,json
src=Path('/home/moloch/semabi/runs/.w3_repair_worktree')
dst=Path('/home/moloch/semabi/runs/.w2_scoring_worktree')

d=json.loads(receipt.read_bytes()); out={}; total=0
for kind in ('copied_corpus_files','verified_existing_suite_files'):

        rel=Path(name); assert not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts

            with b.open('xb') as f:f.write(data)
        assert hashlib.sha256(b.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha
        total+=len(data)
        out[kind][name]={'copy_from':str(a),'candidate_target':str(b),'sha256':sha,'bytes':len(data),'already_present_and_matching':present}

with p.open('x') as f:f.write(json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n')
